// export BalnSwapService = BalnSwapService
declare class BalnSwapService {
    private readonly hubProvider;
    constructor({ hubProvider }: BalnSwapServiceConstructorParams);
    getMultiplierForPeriod(lockupPeriod: LockupPeriod): bigint;
    calculateSodaAmount(balnAmount: bigint, lockupPeriod: LockupPeriod): bigint;
    swapData(balnToken: IconContractAddress, params: BalnMigrateParams, configService: ConfigService): Hex$1;
    claim<R extends boolean = false>(user: Address$1, params: BalnLockParams, walletProviderSlot: WalletProviderSlot<SonicChainKey, R>): Promise<TxReturnType<SonicChainKey, R>>;
    claimUnstaked<R extends boolean = false>(user: Address$1, params: BalnLockParams, walletProviderSlot: WalletProviderSlot<SonicChainKey, R>): Promise<TxReturnType<SonicChainKey, R>>;
    stake<R extends boolean = false>(user: Address$1, params: BalnLockParams, walletProviderSlot: WalletProviderSlot<SonicChainKey, R>): Promise<TxReturnType<SonicChainKey, R>>;
    unstake<R extends boolean = false>(user: Address$1, params: BalnLockParams, walletProviderSlot: WalletProviderSlot<SonicChainKey, R>): Promise<TxReturnType<SonicChainKey, R>>;
    cancelUnstake<R extends boolean = false>(user: Address$1, params: BalnLockParams, walletProviderSlot: WalletProviderSlot<SonicChainKey, R>): Promise<TxReturnType<SonicChainKey, R>>;
    getDetailedUserLocks(publicClient: PublicClient, user: Address$1): Promise<readonly DetailedLock[]>;
    encodeSwap(amount: bigint, lockupPeriod: LockupPeriod, to: Address$1, stake: boolean): EvmContractCall;
    encodeClaim(lockId: bigint): EvmContractCall;
    encodeClaimUnstaked(lockId: bigint): EvmContractCall;
    encodeStake(lockId: bigint): EvmContractCall;

// export IntentRelayRequest = IntentRelayRequest
type IntentRelayRequest<T extends RelayAction> = {
    action: T;
    params: T extends 'submit' ? {
        chain_id: string;
        tx_hash: string;
        data?: RelayExtraData | OnDemandRelayData;
    } : T extends 'get_transaction_packets' ? {
        chain_id: string;
        tx_hash: string;
    } : T extends 'get_packet' ? {
        chain_id: string;
        tx_hash: string;
        conn_sn: string;
    } : never;
};
// export IntentRelayRequestParams = IntentRelayRequestParams
type IntentRelayRequestParams = SubmitTxParams | GetTransactionPacketsParams | GetPacketParams;

// export IntentResponse = IntentResponse
interface IntentResponse {
    intentHash: string;
    txHash: string;
    logIndex: number;
    chainId: number;
    blockNumber: number;
    open: boolean;
    intent: {
        intentId: string;
        creator: string;
        inputToken: string;
        outputToken: string;
        inputAmount: string;
        minOutputAmount: string;
        deadline: string;
        allowPartialFill: boolean;
        srcChain: number;
        dstChain: number;
        srcAddress: string;
        dstAddress: string;
        solver: string;
        data: string;
    };
    events: unknown[];
}
export { IntentResponseV2 } from '@sodax/types';

// export IntentState = IntentState
type IntentState = {
    exists: boolean;
    remainingInput: bigint;
    receivedOutput: bigint;
    pendingPayment: boolean;
};

    tx: TxReturnType<K, Raw>;
    relayData: RelayExtraData;
};

declare class LeverageYieldApiService implements ResultifiedLeverageYieldApiV2 {
    private readonly config;
    private readonly headers;
    private readonly logger;
    private readonly trimsLegacyOverrides;
    constructor(config: BaseApiConfig, logger?: SodaxLogger, options?: LeverageYieldApiServiceOptions);
    private request;
    private static toWireIntent;
    private withQuery;
    getVaults(config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<GetLeverageVaultsResponseV2>>;
    getVault(name: string, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<GetLeverageVaultResponseV2>>;
    getAsset(query: VaultQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<VaultAssetResponseV2>>;
    getPosition(query: VaultQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<LeverageYieldPositionV2>>;
    getApr(query: VaultQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<LeverageYieldAprV2>>;
    getEffectiveApr(query: VaultQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<LeverageYieldEffectiveAprV2>>;
    getLsdApr(query: VaultQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<LeverageYieldLsdAprV2>>;
    getTotalAssets(query: VaultQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<VaultTotalAssetsResponseV2>>;
    previewDeposit(query: VaultAssetsQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<PreviewDepositResponseV2>>;
    previewWithdraw(query: VaultAssetsQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<PreviewWithdrawResponseV2>>;
    previewRedeem(query: VaultSharesQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<PreviewRedeemResponseV2>>;
    getShareBalance(query: VaultOwnerQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<ShareBalanceResponseV2>>;
    getMaxWithdraw(query: VaultOwnerQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<MaxWithdrawResponseV2>>;
    getDepositQuote(body: LeverageYieldDepositQuoteRequestV2, query?: QuoteQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<QuoteResponseV2>>;
    getWithdrawQuote(body: LeverageYieldWithdrawQuoteRequestV2, query?: QuoteQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<QuoteResponseV2>>;
    getDeadline(query?: DeadlineQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<DeadlineResponseV2>>;
    checkAllowance(body: CreateDepositIntentParamsV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<AllowanceCheckResponseV2>>;
    approve(body: CreateDepositIntentParamsV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<ApproveResponseV2>>;
    createDepositIntent(body: CreateDepositIntentParamsV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<CreateIntentResponseV2>>;
    createWithdrawIntent(body: CreateWithdrawIntentParamsV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<CreateIntentResponseV2>>;
    submitIntent(body: SubmitIntentRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<SubmitIntentResponseV2>>;
    getStatus(body: StatusRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<StatusResponseV2>>;
    cancelIntent(body: CancelIntentRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<CancelIntentResponseV2>>;
    getIntentHash(body: IntentHashRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<IntentHashResponseV2>>;
    getSolvedIntentPacket(body: IntentPacketRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<IntentPacketResponseV2>>;
    getIntentSubmitTxExtraData(body: IntentExtraDataRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<IntentExtraDataResponseV2>>;
    getFilledIntent(txHash: string, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<IntentStateV2>>;
    getIntent(txHash: string, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<GetIntentResponseV2>>;
    estimateGas(body: GasEstimateRequestV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<GasEstimateResponseV2>>;
    getPartnerFee(query: FeeQueryV2, config?: RequestOverrideConfig): Promise<Result<FeeResponseV2>>;

// export MoneyMarketService = MoneyMarketService
declare class MoneyMarketService {
    readonly hubProvider: HubProvider;
    readonly config: ConfigService;
    readonly spoke: SpokeService;
    readonly relayerApiEndpoint: HttpUrl;
    readonly data: MoneyMarketDataService;
    get partnerFee(): PartnerFee | undefined;
    constructor({ config, hubProvider, spoke }: MoneyMarketServiceConstructorParams);
    estimateGas<K extends SpokeChainKey>(params: EstimateGasParams<K>): Promise<Result<GetEstimateGasReturnType<K>, MoneyMarketGasEstimationError>>;
    isAllowanceValid<K extends SpokeChainKey>(_params: MoneyMarketAllowanceParams<K>): Promise<Result<boolean, MoneyMarketAllowanceCheckError>>;
    approve<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(_params: MoneyMarketApproveActionParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<TxReturnType<K, Raw>, MoneyMarketApproveError>>;
    supply<K extends SpokeChainKey>(_params: MoneyMarketSupplyActionParams<K, false>): Promise<Result<TxHashPair, MoneyMarketOrchestrationError>>;
    createSupplyIntent<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(_params: MoneyMarketSupplyActionParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<IntentTxResult<K, Raw>, MoneyMarketCreateIntentError>>;
    private buildRelayIdentity;
    borrow<K extends SpokeChainKey>(_params: MoneyMarketBorrowActionParams<K, false>): Promise<Result<TxHashPair, MoneyMarketOrchestrationError>>;
    createBorrowIntent<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(_params: MoneyMarketBorrowActionParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<IntentTxResult<K, Raw>, MoneyMarketCreateIntentError>>;
    withdraw<K extends SpokeChainKey>(_params: MoneyMarketWithdrawActionParams<K, false>): Promise<Result<TxHashPair, MoneyMarketOrchestrationError>>;
    createWithdrawIntent<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(_params: MoneyMarketWithdrawActionParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<IntentTxResult<K, Raw>, MoneyMarketCreateIntentError>>;
    repay<K extends SpokeChainKey>(_params: MoneyMarketRepayActionParams<K, false>): Promise<Result<TxHashPair, MoneyMarketOrchestrationError>>;
    createRepayIntent<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(_params: MoneyMarketRepayActionParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<IntentTxResult<K, Raw>, MoneyMarketCreateIntentError>>;
    buildSupplyData(srcChainKey: SpokeChainKey, fromToken: string, amount: bigint, toHubAddress: Address): Hex;
    buildBorrowData(fromHubAddress: Address, dstAddress: Address, toToken: string, amount: bigint, dstChainKey: SpokeChainKey): Hex;
    buildWithdrawData(fromHubAddress: Address, dstAddress: Address, toToken: string, amount: bigint, dstChainKey: SpokeChainKey): Hex;
    buildRepayData(srcChainKey: SpokeChainKey, fromToken: string, amount: bigint, toHubAddress: Address): Hex;
    static calculateATokenAmount(amount: bigint, normalizedIncome: bigint): bigint;
    static encodeSupply(params: MoneyMarketEncodeSupplyParams, lendingPool: Address): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeWithdraw(params: MoneyMarketEncodeWithdrawParams, lendingPool: Address): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeBorrow(params: MoneyMarketEncodeBorrowParams, lendingPool: Address): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeRepay(params: MoneyMarketEncodeRepayParams, lendingPool: Address): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeRepayWithATokens(params: MoneyMarketEncodeRepayWithATokensParams, lendingPool: Address): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeSetUserUseReserveAsCollateral(asset: Address, useAsCollateral: boolean, lendingPool: Address): EvmContractCall;
    getSupportedTokensByChainId(chainId: SpokeChainKey): readonly XToken[];
    getSupportedTokens(): GetMoneyMarketTokensApiResponse;
    getSupportedReserves(): readonly Address[];
}

declare class Permit2Service {
    private constructor();
    static getAllowance(permit2: Address$1, user: Address$1, token: Address$1, spender: Address$1, publicClient: PublicClient): Promise<Result<AllowanceInfo>>;
    static isAllowanceValid(permit2: Address$1, user: Address$1, token: Address$1, spender: Address$1, amount: bigint, publicClient: PublicClient): Promise<Result<boolean>>;
    static approve<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, token: Address$1, spender: Address$1, amount: bigint, expiration: number, walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static permit<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, owner: Address$1, permitSingle: PermitSingle, signature: `0x${string}`, walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static permitBatch<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, owner: Address$1, permitBatch: PermitBatch, signature: `0x${string}`, walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static transferFrom<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, from: Address$1, to: Address$1, amount: bigint, token: Address$1, walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static transferFromBatch<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, transferDetails: AllowanceTransferDetails[], walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static lockdown<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, approvals: TokenSpenderPair[], walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static invalidateNonces<R extends boolean = false>(srcAddress: Address$1, permit2: Address$1, token: Address$1, spender: Address$1, newNonce: number, walletProvider: IEvmWalletProvider, raw?: R): Promise<TxReturnType<EvmChainKey, R>>;
    static encodeApprove(permit2: Address$1, token: Address$1, spender: Address$1, amount: bigint, expiration: number): EvmContractCall;
    static encodePermit(permit2: Address$1, owner: Address$1, permitSingle: PermitSingle, signature: `0x${string}`): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeTransferFrom(permit2: Address$1, from: Address$1, to: Address$1, amount: bigint, token: Address$1): EvmContractCall;
    static encodeTransferFromBatch(permit2: Address$1, transferDetails: AllowanceTransferDetails[]): EvmContractCall;

// export SodaxError = SodaxError
declare class SodaxError<C extends SodaxErrorCode = SodaxErrorCode> extends Error {
    readonly code: C;
    readonly feature: SodaxFeature;
    readonly cause?: unknown;
    readonly context?: SodaxErrorContext;
    constructor(code: C, message: string, options: {
        feature: SodaxFeature;
        cause?: unknown;
        context?: SodaxErrorContext;
    });
    toJSON(): SodaxErrorJSON<C>;
}
// export SodaxErrorCode = SodaxErrorCode
type SodaxErrorCode = 'USER_REJECTED' | 'VALIDATION_FAILED' | 'INTENT_CREATION_FAILED' | 'EXECUTION_FAILED' | 'TX_VERIFICATION_FAILED' | 'TX_SUBMIT_FAILED' | 'RELAY_TIMEOUT' | 'RELAY_FAILED' | 'APPROVE_FAILED' | 'ALLOWANCE_CHECK_FAILED' | 'GAS_ESTIMATION_FAILED' | 'LOOKUP_FAILED' | 'EXTERNAL_API_ERROR' | 'UNKNOWN';
// export SodaxErrorContext = SodaxErrorContext
type SodaxErrorContext = {
    action?: string;
    phase?: SodaxPhase;
    srcChainKey?: string;
    dstChainKey?: string;
    relayCode?: RelayCode;
    api?: 'solver' | 'backend' | 'swaps' | 'leverageYield' | 'sponsoring' | 'bridge';
    method?: string;
    status?: number;
    nextAction?: string;
    retryable?: boolean;
    retryAfterSeconds?: number;
    sponsorSequence?: string;
    direction?: 'forward' | 'reverse';
    field?: string;
    reason?: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};
// export SodaxErrorJSON = SodaxErrorJSON
type SodaxErrorJSON<C extends SodaxErrorCode = SodaxErrorCode> = {
    name: string;
    code: C;
    feature: SodaxFeature;
    message: string;
    stack?: string;
    context?: SodaxErrorContext;
    cause?: unknown;
};

// export SpokeIsAllowanceValidParams = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParams
type SpokeIsAllowanceValidParams<K extends SpokeChainKey = SpokeChainKey> = K extends EvmChainKey ? K extends HubChainKey ? SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsHub<K> : SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsEvmSpoke<EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey> : K extends HubChainKey ? SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsHub<K> : K extends EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey ? SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsEvmSpoke<K> : K extends StellarChainKey ? SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsStellar<K> : K extends OtherSpokeChainKey ? SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsOther<K> : never;
// export SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsEvmSpoke = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsEvmSpoke
type SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsEvmSpoke<K extends EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey = EvmSpokeOnlyChainKey> = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsCommon & {
    srcChainKey: K;
    spender: Address;
};
// export SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsHub = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsHub
type SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsHub<K extends HubChainKey = HubChainKey> = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsCommon & {
    srcChainKey: K;
    spender: Address;
};
// export SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsOther = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsOther
type SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsOther<K extends OtherSpokeChainKey = OtherSpokeChainKey> = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsCommon & {
    srcChainKey: K;
};
// export SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsStellar = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsStellar
type SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsStellar<K extends StellarChainKey = StellarChainKey> = SpokeIsAllowanceValidParamsCommon & {
    srcChainKey: K;
};
// export SpokeService = SpokeService
declare class SpokeService {
    private readonly hubProvider;
    private readonly config;
    readonly evm: EvmSpokeService;
    readonly sonic: SonicSpokeService;
    readonly injective: InjectiveSpokeService;
    readonly icon: IconSpokeService;
    readonly sui: SuiSpokeService;
    readonly solana: SolanaSpokeService;
    readonly stellar: StellarSpokeService;
    readonly bitcoin: BitcoinSpokeService;
    readonly near: NearSpokeService;
    readonly stacks: StacksSpokeService;
    constructor({ config, hubProvider }: SpokeServiceConstructorParams);
    getSpokeService<C extends SpokeChainKey>(chainKey: C): GetSpokeServiceType<C>;
    isAllowanceValid(params: SpokeIsAllowanceValidParams): Promise<Result<boolean>>;
    approve<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(params: SpokeApproveParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<TxReturnType<K, Raw>>>;
    buildApproveTxs<K extends SpokeChainKey>(params: SpokeApproveParams<K, true>): Promise<Result<ApprovalTxs<K>>>;
    private executeErc20ApprovalPlan;
    private requestTrustlineForApproval;
    private planErc20Approval;
    private getEvmPublicClient;
    private logApprovalPlan;
    estimateGas<C extends SpokeChainKey>(params: EstimateGasParams<C>): Promise<Result<GetEstimateGasReturnType<C>>>;
    static encodeTransfer(token: Hex, from: Hex, to: Hex, amount: bigint, data: Hex): Hex;
    simulateDeposit(params: DepositParams<SpokeChainKey, boolean>): Promise<Result<boolean>>;
    private resolveSimulationEncoding;
    simulateRecvMessage(params: WalletSimulationParams): Promise<Result<boolean>>;
    deposit<K extends SpokeChainKey, R extends boolean>(params: DepositParams<K, R>): Promise<Result<TxReturnType<K, R>>>;
    verifyDepositSimulation<C extends SpokeChainKey, R extends boolean>(params: DepositParams<C, R>): Promise<Result<void>>;
    getDeposit<C extends SpokeChainKey>(params: GetDepositParams<C>): Promise<Result<bigint>>;
    getWalletBalance<C extends SpokeChainKey>(params: GetBalanceParams<C>): Promise<Result<bigint>>;
    getWalletBalances<C extends SpokeChainKey>(params: GetBalancesParams<C>): Promise<Result<WalletBalanceMap>>;
    sendMessage<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(params: SendMessageParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<TxReturnType<K, Raw>>>;
    verifySimulation<K extends SpokeChainKey, Raw extends boolean>(params: VerifySimulationParams<K, Raw>): Promise<Result<void>>;
    getLimit(token: string, chainId: SpokeChainKey): Promise<Result<bigint>>;
    getAvailable(token: string, chainId: SpokeChainKey): Promise<Result<bigint>>;
    verifyTxHash(params: VerifyTxHashParams): Promise<Result<boolean>>;
    private verifyReceiptStatus;
    waitForTxReceipt<C extends SpokeChainKey = SpokeChainKey>(params: WaitForTxReceiptParams<C>): Promise<Result<WaitForTxReceiptReturnType<C>>>;
}
